description: Perform one action in a session and return the new observation (screenshot + elements + errors). Actions: click (index | text | selector | role+name | x+y), type (target + value + submit?), scroll (dy?), press (key), goto (url), back, reload, wait (ms). Prefer the `index` of an element from the latest observation.

index.description: Element index from the latest observation (1-based)

text.description: Visible text to match (click target or input label)

name: session_act
